description.value: Uptown Bistro is a neighbourhood Canadian bistro serving brunch and modern Canadian cuisine with an ingredient-driven approach using organic, sustainable meats and seasonal produce. The room is described as intimate and warm, with a comfortable bar area, handcrafted cocktails, and a curated wine list. Cyclists passing through Victoria's Boleskine Road corridor will find a relaxed, full-service dining experience with takeout also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and corroborates the OSM address, phone, and email exactly. The homepage explicitly advertises 'Call 778.265.7745 for Take Out,' confirming takeout service. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website text; the 'ample free parking' reference on the About page refers to car parking only.
concerns: The About page was written prospectively ('Since its doors will be opening on 1st November 2016') and has never been updated, suggesting the website content is largely static since the 2016 launch. Core contact details remain consistent so no action required, but amenity information may be incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating neighbourhood bistro with active website, confirmed address, and publicly accessible dining and takeout service.

wow_evidence: neighbourhood Canadian bistro serving brunch and modern Canadian cuisine

price.label: Casual
